title: User Registration Success
description: Verify that a new user can successfully register with valid information and receive a JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to the signup modal.
Enter valid user details (username, email, password).
Submit the registration form.
Verify registration success message is shown.
Verify JWT token is received and stored in session.

title: User Registration with Existing Email
description: Ensure registration fails if the email is already registered.

steps.description: Open signup modal.
Enter an email already in use.
Submit the registration form.
Verify error message indicating email already registered.

title: User Login Success
description: Validate that a registered user can login with correct credentials and receive a valid JWT token.

steps.description: Open login modal.
Enter valid username/email and password.
Submit login form.
Verify user is authenticated and JWT token is stored in session.
Verify dashboard with career metrics is displayed.

title: User Login Failure with Invalid Credentials
description: Ensure login fails with incorrect username/email or password and proper error is shown.

steps.description: Open login modal.
Enter invalid username/email or password.
Submit login form.
Verify error message indicating login failure.

title: Dashboard Data Accuracy
description: Verify that the dashboard correctly displays up-to-date career metrics and relevant quick links after login.

steps.description: Login as a valid user.
Navigate to dashboard page or view default homepage.
Verify career metrics reflect current user data.
Verify quick links to key features are visible and functional.

title: Certificate Explorer Search Validity
description: Validate that searching certificates by keywords returns accurate and relevant results.

steps.description: Navigate to Certificate Explorer.
Enter keyword in search bar and execute search.
Verify the displayed certificates match the search query.
Verify no irrelevant certificates are shown.

title: Save and Retrieve Certificates
description: Ensure user can save certificates and that saved certificates persist during the session.

steps.description: Browse certificates and select some to save/bookmark.
Access saved items section.
Verify previously saved certificates appear in saved items.
Verify saved items remain after page refresh during the session.

title: Internship Board Filtering
description: Verify filtering internships by location and stipend returns accurate results.

steps.description: Navigate to Internship Board.
Apply filter by location.
Apply filter by stipend range.
Verify internships shown meet filter criteria.

title: Internship Application process
description: Verify users can apply to internships successfully and receive confirmation.

steps.description: Browse internship listings.
Select an internship and click apply.
Verify application form or confirmation prompt is displayed.
Submit application.
Verify application success message or notification.

title: Hackathon Hub Event Discovery and Bookmarking
description: Validate browsing upcoming hackathons, checking prize details, and saving events functionality.

steps.description: Navigate to Hackathon Hub.
Browse list of upcoming hackathons.
View prize details of selected hackathon.
Bookmark/save hackathon for later reference.
Verify bookmarked hackathon appears in saved items.

title: Tech News Feed Category Filtering and Search
description: Verify tech news feed can be filtered by category (AI, Cybersecurity, Data Science) and searched accurately.

steps.description: Navigate to Tech News section.
Select category filter (e.g., Cybersecurity).
Verify news articles shown belong to selected category.
Use search bar to find news containing specific keywords.
Verify news articles match search query.

title: AI Tools Directory Browsing for Skill Levels
description: Ensure AI tools are displayed correctly based on skill level filters.

steps.description: Navigate to AI Tools Directory.
Select a skill level filter (e.g., beginner, intermediate, advanced).
Verify displayed tools match the selected skill level.

title: Project Generator Functionality
description: Verify users are able to generate and view curated and on-demand project ideas successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to Project Generator section.
Request curated project ideas.
Verify relevant curated project ideas are displayed.
Request on-demand generated projects for specific criteria.
Verify custom generated project ideas meet criteria.

title: Saved Items Management
description: Confirm users can view and remove saved certificates, internships, and hackathons reliably.

steps.description: Navigate to Saved Items section.
Verify all previously saved items are listed.
Remove one saved certificate, internship, and hackathon each.
Verify the removed items no longer appear in saved items.

title: Dark and Light Theme Toggle
description: Verify the UI correctly switches between dark and light modes and persists user preference.

steps.description: Locate theme toggle control and switch to dark mode.
Verify UI elements update to dark theme styles.
Switch back to light mode.
Verify UI elements update to light theme styles.
Refresh the page and verify previously selected theme persists.

title: Responsive Design Check
description: Verify the application layout and functionality adjusts correctly across different device screen sizes.

steps.description: Open the application on desktop, tablet, and mobile screen sizes.
Verify content is visible, aligned, and functional on all screen sizes.
Verify navigation menus and key features are accessible.
Verify smooth scrolling and animations work correctly on all devices.

title: API Endpoint Error Handling
description: Ensure that API endpoints return appropriate HTTP status codes and error responses on failure.

steps.description: Simulate backend API failure or invalid request for certificates, internships, and projects.
Verify API returns appropriate error HTTP status codes (4xx or 5xx).
Verify user sees graceful error messages without app crashing.

title: Self-contained Mode Fallback with Mock Data
description: Verify the application functions fully using mock data when live backend/database is unavailable.

steps.description: Disable live backend API or simulate backend unavailability.
Interact with all major features (certificates, internships, projects, news, tools).
Verify data loads correctly using mock data without errors.
Verify user can perform search, filter, save item functions normally.

title: Profile and Skills Update Synchronization
description: Validate that user profile updates, including skills, are saved and synchronized correctly.

steps.description: Login and navigate to profile settings.
Edit personal information and skills.
Save changes.
Verify updated data is persisted and reflected immediately in profile.
Reload page and confirm updates remain.

title: Deployment Scripts and Docker Configurations
description: Verify the deployment scripts and Docker configurations deploy frontend, backend, and database for both local and cloud environments successfully.

steps.description: Run deployment scripts locally in a clean environment.
Verify all components (frontend, backend, database) start successfully.
Deploy using Docker configuration on cloud environment.
Verify full application is accessible and functional.
